Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Transport, logistică, lanț de aprovizionare și depozitare și Fabricația de utilaje industriale
Job description:
 Join Jungheinrich in a working environment where you can make a big difference! With your knowledge and drive, as a team player you will make an important contribution to ensure that we as a company continue to be among the global leaders in our industry. Working side by side with colleagues who enjoy bold ideas and in a family environment that offers you every opportunity to reconcile your professional and private goals.
 Your main responsibilities: 
Support the implementation and rollout of the new Transfer Pricing model within the Intercompany Pricing (ICP) project, ensuring alignment with global business requirements.
Collaborate closely with Headquarters and cross-functional stakeholders to analyze, document, and implement transfer pricing processes and guidelines.
Prepare, review, and validate transfer pricing calculations, allocations, and intercompany pricing mechanisms.
Analyze financial and operational data to support transfer pricing decisions and identify opportunities for process improvements.
Ensure compliance with internal transfer pricing policies, corporate governance standards, and applicable tax regulations.
Support the preparation of transfer pricing documentation, reports, and management presentations.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical tools using Power BI and other data analytics solutions.
Partner with Controlling, Finance, Tax, and Business teams to ensure accurate implementation of transfer pricing principles across business processes.
Participate in transfer pricing projects, audits, and process optimization initiatives.
Provide expert support for intercompany transactions, pricing analyses, and related business requests.
 Therefore, a successful candidate would have: 
Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of professional experience in Transfer Pricing within a Big Four preferred.
Strong understanding of Transfer Pricing concepts, methodologies, and regulatory requirements.
Good knowledge of Controlling and Finance processes within an international business environment.
Advanced analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial and operational data.
Experience with Power BI and data analytics tools for reporting, visualization, and business insights.
Strong MS Office skills, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
Fluent English language skills; German would be considered an advantage.
Structured and detail-oriented working style with excellent problem-solving capabilities.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in international and cross-functional teams.
Proactive mindset, willingness to drive improvements, and ownership of assigned topics.
 Jungheinrich was founded in 1953 in Hamburg by Dr. Friedrich Jungheinrich as a family business. Today, we are one of the world's leading intralogistics companies with a unique product portfolio: from conventional industrial trucks to fully automated solutions intralogistics companies. Headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, Jungheinrich is represented by its own direct sales companies in 41 countries and by partner companies in around 80 other countries around the world, and employs more than 19,000 people internationally.
 We look forward to receiving your online application.
 For questions, please contact our Recruiter.
